# `dump --stage checked` prints an event's parameter list back.
#
# The IR carries an event's parameters rather than a single payload type, and
# ir.Convert has to spell each form so it parses as the same declaration: a
# list with names, the bare one-parameter `@name T`, and `@name()`, which
# passes nothing. Dumping twice and comparing is what catches a form that
# reads back as a different declaration.

sngl dump --stage checked app.sngl
cp stdout first.sngl
sngl check first.sngl
sngl dump --stage checked first.sngl
cp stdout second.sngl
cmp first.sngl second.sngl

grep '@pick\(index int, label string\)' first.sngl
grep '@change int' first.sngl
grep '@done\(\)' first.sngl

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component picker(@pick(index int, label string), @change int, @done()) node {
    button(text="a", @click {
        pick(0, "a")
        change(1)
        done()
    })
}

component main node {
    var at = 0

    picker(@pick(i, l) { at = i }, @change(v) { at = v }, @done { at = 0 })
    text(value="{at}")
}

window {
    main
}
